title: Winter Break Campus Hours
description: The library and student services desk will operate on reduced hours during winter break. Check the campus calendar for updated opening times.

title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedule Released
description: The mid-semester timetable is available on the student portal. Review your exam date, time, and room before the first examination.

title: Research Skills Sessions Open for Booking
description: The library is accepting bookings for short workshops on academic databases, citations, and research planning.

title: Student Innovation Hackathon Registration
description: Registration is open for the November innovation hackathon. Teams of up to four students may submit an idea before the deadline.

title: Temporary Classroom Change for Block B
description: Classes scheduled in Block B room 204 will meet in room 118 while maintenance is completed. The timetable has been updated.

title: Scholarship Application Deadline Reminder
description: Submit supporting documents for the current scholarship cycle through the student services office before the posted deadline.

title: Sports Fest Venue Confirmed
description: The Inter-College Sports Fest will take place at the University Sports Ground. Participants should review the event information for arrival details.
